leading_hypothesis: WP03 semantic identity should decode JSON STRING escape spelling to the same Unicode scalar sequence while preserving source spelling separately and without silently adding Unicode normalization policy.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Raw spelling should remain part of semantic_ir_sha256, or NFC normalization should be applied at this boundary so canonically equivalent scalar sequences collapse as well.

external_primary_evidence.finding: Unicode JSON string content is independent of escape spelling; unpaired UTF-16 surrogates are not interoperable.
NFC/NFD are explicit normalization policies; normalization is distinct from decoding and not mandatory for every process.

surrogate_probe.required_boundary: retain explicit Unicode scalar validation before semantic admission

interpretation: The minimal candidate is semantic STRING decoding plus scalar validation, not NFC normalization. Exact lexical spelling remains available through source_sha256. Prefer sharing the already-tested WP02 STRING decoder/canonical semantic primitive over duplicating JSON token semantics in WP03.
test_delta: After WP02 current-main closure, run the identity triad through exact lower_program under the selected strict grammar.
Require semantic_ir_sha256 equality for escape-equivalent decoded scalar sequences.
Keep precomposed/decomposed scalar sequences distinct unless a future explicit normalization contract is admitted.
Reject unpaired surrogates before semantic identity is minted; preserve source_sha256 for lexical/provenance identity.
rollback: Receipt-only research delta; no ClayCode source, Frank Harness, release gate or effect authority changed.
